import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
/**
 * 悬赏榜
 * 指令：/悬赏榜
 *
 * 展示当前活跃的悬赏列表
 */

import App from '@src/response-apps/bounty/list/app';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { createQuoteMarkdown, FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';
const bountyHeader = [
  { label: '悬赏榜', command: '/悬赏榜' },
  { label: '杀神榜', command: '/杀神榜' }
];

const bountyFooter = [
  { label: '记录', command: '/打劫记录' },
  { label: '悬赏', command: '/悬赏' },
  { label: '仇人', command: '/仇人' },
  { label: '煞气', command: '/煞气' },
  { label: '金盆', command: '/消耗 金盆 1' }
];

export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;
  const text = (e.MessageText ?? '').trim();

  const pageMatch = text.match(/(?:悬赏榜)\s*(\d+)?$/);
  const page = pageMatch?.[1] ? parseInt(pageMatch[1], 10) : 1;

  const result = await App({ page, bid });
  const { list, total, totalPages } = result.data;

  const md = Format.createMarkdown();

  if (list.length === 0) {
    md.addText('当前没有进行中的悬赏');
    md.addNewline();

    void message.send(
      FormatGui({
        isPrivate,
        bid,
        title: '悬赏榜',
        content: md,
        header: bountyHeader,
        footer: bountyFooter
      })
    );

    return;
  }

  for (const b of list) {
    md.addNewline();
    md.addBlockquote(
      createQuoteMarkdown(
        [
          `${b.id} 目标：${b.targetName}(UID:${b.targetUid})`,
          `赏金：${b.rewardPerCompletion}灵晶/人 · 剩余${b.remainingSlots}/${b.maxCompletions}人 · ${b.hoursLeft}h`
        ],
        [
          { label: '查看', command: `/查看信息 ${b.targetUid}` },
          { label: '接赏', command: `/接赏 ${b.id}` }
        ]
      )
    );
  }

  void message.send(
    FormatGui({
      isPrivate,
      bid,
      title: '悬赏榜',
      content: md,
      nav:
        totalPages > 1
          ? {
              current: result.data.page,
              total: totalPages,
              count: total,
              command: '/悬赏榜 {page}'
            }
          : undefined,
      header: bountyHeader,
      footer: bountyFooter
    })
  );
});
